evidence.explanation: Scheme row 1 reads 'INTRODUCTION TO CHEMISTRY' and matches the week topic line 'TOPIC: INTRODUCTION TO CHEMISTRY' exactly, so the mapping is by title as well as by position. Week One is the first of ten body markers (CHEM-INV-T1A). The scheme row carries no sub-items, so the objectives below come from the week's own headings.

The body has twelve content sections (CONTENT list, science and chemistry, branches, scientific methods, two evaluations, applications, careers, general evaluation, reading, weekend and theory blocks). PARTIAL, not SUPPORTED: the source teaches the topic, but no deliverable lesson exists, no lesson id is bound (no importer run), and the week's questions carry no answers or marking. The importer was not run, so no parsed-row identity is confirmed and none is bound here as a lesson id. Week One contains no image, text box, table or equation (checked in the DOCX XML), so no visual item is raised for it.
